Think you can translate the translation?|[[Den Dhur]] to [[Laranth Tarak]] after viewing a translated message from a Cephalon|<ref name="Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>}}
'''Aoloiloa''', literally "the one before Lo and after Il," was a [[Cephalon]] who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Cephalon did not support the Empire, however, and joined an underground resistance movement known as [[Whiplash]]. Around this time, Aoloiloa was visited by two Whiplash members, the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gray Paladin]] [[Laranth Tarak]] and ex-[[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Den Dhur]]. However, due to the Cephalon's four-dimensional perception of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], it was unable to communicate effectively with Dhur and Tarak.
